one_liner: Hosted ecommerce platform for building and running online stores.

auth.notes: Public/partner apps use OAuth2 authorization code flow to get a merchant access token; custom apps installed directly on one store use a static Admin API access token. Not WebFetched this pass, based on search summaries of shopify.dev content.

access.notes: Free Shopify Partner dev stores are available for building/testing. Public apps distributed to arbitrary merchants require Shopify app review before public listing/production use at scale.

api.notes: Admin GraphQL API schema is very large (broad). Shopify publishes multiple official MCP servers (Admin, Storefront, Customer Account MCP) per shopify.dev.

verdict.rationale: Free dev stores, OAuth2, broad REST/GraphQL API, and official MCP servers make this readily buildable.
